embryonic-limit.name: embryonic-limit
embryonic-limit.help: Maximum number of IPsec tunnels to negotiate simultaneously.

dh-multiprocess.name: dh-multiprocess
dh-multiprocess.help: Enable/disable multiprocess Diffie-Hellman daemon for IKE.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable multiprocess Diffie-Hellman for IKE.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable multiprocess Diffie-Hellman for IKE.

dh-worker-count.name: dh-worker-count
dh-worker-count.help: Number of Diffie-Hellman workers to start.

dh-mode.name: dh-mode
dh-mode.help: Use software (CPU) or hardware (CPX) to perform Diffie-Hellman calculations.

options.name: software
options.help: Prefer CPU to perform Diffie-Hellman calculations.

options.name: hardware
options.help: Prefer CPX to perform Diffie-Hellman calculations.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache.

dh-keypair-count.name: dh-keypair-count
dh-keypair-count.help: Number of key pairs to pre-generate for each Diffie-Hellman group (per-worker).

dh-keypair-throttle.name: dh-keypair-throttle
dh-keypair-throttle.help: Enable/disable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache CPU throttling.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache CPU throttling.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache CPU throttling.
